title: Governance Automation Roadmap
description: Maturity model and phased roadmap for governance automation from P0 (current) through P4 (self-healing future state).

phases.name: Automated Detection
phases.description: All 8 governance rules have automated detection. Four production scripts operational.
deliverables: governance_guard_engine.js — Rules 1-8 validation
policy_drift_detector.js — 5-dimension drift detection
certification_audit_builder.js — audit chain generation
governance_event_registry.js — event lifecycle tracking

gates.G1_DETECTION: All 8 rules detectable by CLI tools
gates.G3_AUDIT_CHAINS: Per-QID audit chains buildable from REVISION_HISTORY.md

phases.name: Continuous Monitoring
phases.description: Governance checks run at every session boundary. Dashboard populated with live data. Event registry actively tracking violations.
deliverables: Session startup protocol: run governance_guard_engine.js + policy_drift_detector.js at T0
Dashboard populated: connect build_dashboard.js to engine output
Event registry active: auto-ingest from guard engine output
Drift baseline established: S751 T0 snapshot
Metrics baseline computed: initial values for all 14 metrics

gates.G1_T0_SCAN: Every session runs governance guard engine at startup
gates.G2_DASHBOARD: Dashboard renders live data from engine output
gates.G4_METRICS_BASELINE: All 14 metrics computed at least once

phases.name: Pre-Commit Gates
phases.description: Governance checks integrated into CI/CD pipeline. Pull requests blocked on new DL-008 violations. Automated pre-certification gates.
deliverables: Pre-commit hook: governance_guard_engine.js blocks commits with new DL-008
CI pipeline: governance checks run on PR merge
Pre-certification gate: automated go/no-go based on drift detector
Baseline comparison: delta between current scan and T0 baseline triggers alerts
Automated REVISION_HISTORY.md reminder: Rule 1 enforced at commit time

gates.G2_CI: Governance checks run in CI pipeline

phases.name: Predictive Governance
phases.description: Trend analysis on governance metrics. Early warning on drift patterns. Automated root-cause correlation across defect clusters.
deliverables: Trend dashboard: 30-day metrics visualized with trendlines
Early warning: alerts when drift patterns accelerate
Root-cause correlation: linked defects auto-clustered
Recurrence prediction: QIDs likely to re-violate flagged
Workload forecasting: estimated sessions to full compliance

gates.G1_TRENDS: Metrics trendlines renderable from event registry data

phases.name: Self-Healing Governance
phases.description: Automated remediation of known defect patterns. AI-driven certification support. Closed-loop governance: detect → remediate → verify → close.
deliverables: Auto-remediation: DL-008 clears auto-applied for Bucket 1 (calculation summaries)
AI certification support: build-time AI runs CAQS §1.6 verification autonomously
Closed-loop: detect → remediate → verify → close → re-scan
Adaptive baselines: drift expectations calibrated to development velocity
Zero-touch governance: routine defects resolved without human intervention

gates.G3_CLOSED_LOOP: Full detect→close cycle automated for ≥80% of defect classes

riskFactors.mitigation: Shared extraction logic; test parity suite
Role-based controls are advisory until portal deployed
Auto-ingestion from engine output ensures population
Phased: pre-commit hook first, CI pipeline second
